description: This file defines a class 'Smarty_Internal_Runtime_FilterHandler' responsible for managing and executing filter plugins within the Smarty template engine. It includes methods for running filters of various types ('pre', 'post', 'output') on template content, supporting lazy loading and dynamic invocation of filter plugins.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_FilterHandler
classes.description: Handles the runtime filtering of template content by dynamically loading and executing registered and auto-loaded filter plugins.

methods.name: runFilter
methods.description: Executes all applicable 'pre', 'post', or 'output' filters on given content, handling auto-loading, callable plugin invocation, and exception handling for plugin loading failures.
